name: analysis-aggregate-sparse-breakdowns
description: Totalling all donors' 2022 health and education ODA to Kenya by donor and sector refuses coverage_insufficient, since most donors fund only some sectors and the grid counts each empty breakdown cell as missing. The same tree with allow_sparse_breakdowns true answers the frame.

json.title: Coverage Insufficient
json.detail: Only 19.2% of the expected grid is present (1628 cell(s) missing), below the 50% floor. Narrow group_by to a coarser grain and retry. The grid counts the breakdown column(s) ['stat_var_crsPurpose'], whose empty cells may be no gap: pass allow_sparse_breakdowns=true to count coverage without them.
